staking.pageSubtitle: Lock funds for a fixed term and earn daily interest.
staking.whatIsStakingBody: Staking locks your tokens to help validate and secure the blockchain. In return you earn rewards (shown as APY — annual percentage yield). Your keys stay self-custodial; assets in a lock period can't be moved until the timer ends.
staking.comingSoonBody: Earn rewards on your crypto. We're putting the finishing touches on staking — it'll be live here soon.
staking.noProducts: No staking offers available right now.
staking.noStakes: You don't have any stakes yet.
staking.maturedNote: When a stake matures, your principal becomes available in your wallet. Interest earned is credited to your staking ledger, shown above — it is not yet paid out to your wallet balance.

autoRenew.optInHelp: When this term ends, the same amount is staked again on this product for another {termDays} days. Interest already earned is not included. You can turn this off any time before maturity.
autoRenew.stateOnClosed: Auto-renew: On · this product is closed to new stakes, so renewal will probably not be possible.
autoRenew.stateOnOverCap: Auto-renew: On · this stake's term is longer than {maxTermDays} days, so it will not renew. Your principal will be available when it matures on {date}.
autoRenew.stateOnGranted: Auto-renew: On · this stake was granted by BANA, so it will not renew. Your principal will be available when it matures on {date}.
autoRenew.offToast: Auto-renew is off. Your principal will be available when this stake matures on {date}.
autoRenew.confirmBody1: On {maturityDate}, {principal} {coin} will be staked again on {productName} for another {termDays} days at the rate offered at that time.
autoRenew.confirmLock: Staked funds cannot be withdrawn before the new term ends.
autoRenew.confirmBody2: Interest already earned is not restaked.
autoRenew.confirmBody3: You can turn this off any time before {maturityDate}.
autoRenew.renewedCopy: {principal} {coin} was staked again on {productName} for {termDays} days at {dailyRatePct}%/day. The new term started {startAt}. Interest earned on the previous term was not included.
autoRenew.notRenewedClosedCopy: {productName} is closed to new stakes. Your {principal} {coin} principal is available in your wallet.
autoRenew.notRenewedTermTooLongCopy: Auto-renew isn't available on stakes with a term longer than {maxTermDays} days. Your {principal} {coin} principal is available in your wallet.
autoRenew.notRenewedCapacityCopy: {productName} is full. Your {principal} {coin} principal is available in your wallet.
autoRenew.notRenewedBelowMinCopy: The minimum for {productName} is now {minAmount} {coin}. Your {principal} {coin} principal is available in your wallet.
autoRenew.notRenewedAboveMaxCopy: The maximum for {productName} is now {maxAmount} {coin}. Your {principal} {coin} principal is available in your wallet.
autoRenew.notRenewedRateLoweredCopy: The rate for {productName} changed to {dailyRatePct}%/day, lower than the {oldRate}%/day on your stake. We didn't renew on different terms. Your {principal} {coin} principal is available in your wallet.
autoRenew.notRenewedTermsChangedCopy: The terms of {productName} changed. Your {principal} {coin} principal is available in your wallet.
autoRenew.notRenewedSystemErrorCopy: We couldn't complete the renewal. Your {principal} {coin} principal is available in your wallet.

adminSettings.whitelistBody: When on, users can only withdraw to addresses saved in their address book. Blocks withdrawals to brand-new addresses.
adminSettings.autoApproveBody: Stablecoin withdrawals valued under this amount skip the approval queue and send automatically. Larger amounts (and all non-stablecoins) still require manual review. Leave blank to require approval for everything.

adminSettings.stakingWorkerBody: Controls how often the background worker pays out staking interest. The worker runs continuously — no manual trigger needed.

autoRenewWarning.inlineTitle: Lowering the rate will refuse {count, plural, one {# pending auto-renewal} other {# pending auto-renewals}}.
autoRenewWarning.inlineBody: {count, plural, one {# active position} other {# active positions}} on {productName} {count, plural, one {has} other {have}} auto-renew on. Each one is checked against this product's rate at the moment it matures. If the saved rate is lower than the rate on the position, that renewal is refused and the principal is released to the user's wallet instead of being staked again.
autoRenewWarning.inlineRestore: Raising the rate back before a position matures restores that position's renewal — only the value at the moment of maturity is used.
autoRenewWarning.inlineSnapshot: Positions already staked keep the rate they were staked at. This change does not alter what any existing position earns.
autoRenewWarning.confirmBody: {count, plural, one {# active position} other {# active positions}} on this product {count, plural, one {has} other {have}} auto-renew on. Those renewals will be refused at maturity and the principal released to the user's wallet.
autoRenewWarning.confirmSnapshot: Existing positions keep the rate they were staked at.

autoRenewReminder.subject: Your {productName} stake matures on {maturityDate} and is set to renew
autoRenewReminder.body1: Your stake of {principal} {coin} on {productName} matures on {maturityDate}.
autoRenewReminder.body2: Auto-renew is on for this stake. Unless you turn it off before then, the same amount — {principal} {coin} — will be staked again on {productName} for another {termDays} days at the rate offered at that time. Interest already earned is not included.
autoRenewReminder.lock: Staked funds cannot be withdrawn before the new term ends.
autoRenewReminder.body3: To turn auto-renew off: open BANA Wallet, go to Staking, find this stake under My Stakes, and switch auto-renew off. It takes one tap, there is no confirmation step, and you can do it any time before {maturityDate}.
autoRenewReminder.body4: If auto-renew is off when this stake matures, your principal simply becomes available in your wallet.

autoRenewOutcome.renewedIntro: Your stake on {productName} matured on {maturedAt} and was staked again.
autoRenewOutcome.renewedInterestNote: Interest earned on the previous term was not included — only the principal was staked again.
